name: GreebleFS Core Hotkeys
description: Canonical shipped hotkey bindings and default shortcut map.

bindings.label: Toggle Dev Telemetry HUD
bindings.description: Show or hide the developer telemetry HUD while local developer tooling is active.

bindings.label: Toggle Main Window
bindings.description: Global shortcut used to open or hide the app window in its current presentation mode.

bindings.label: Focus Terminal
bindings.description: Jump directly into the terminal panel, or reveal the explorer bottom terminal drawer when an explorer has focus.

bindings.label: Toggle App/Dock Mode
bindings.description: Switch between the dock-style overlay shell and the regular desktop application window.

bindings.label: Toggle Zen Focus Mode
bindings.description: Hide or restore the shell top bar and foreground the explorer for a cleaner focus pass.

bindings.label: Toggle Lookdev Overlay
bindings.description: Open or close the immersive semantic lookdev overlay over the live shell.

bindings.label: Zoom Overlay
bindings.description: Hold the modifier and scroll anywhere in the overlay to change zoom.

bindings.label: Zoom App In
bindings.description: Increase the global shell zoom while the app window is focused.

bindings.label: Zoom App Out
bindings.description: Decrease the global shell zoom while the app window is focused.

bindings.label: Opacity Overlay
bindings.description: Hold the modifier and scroll anywhere in the overlay to change opacity.

bindings.label: Command Palette
bindings.description: Global shortcut used to open the overlay command palette.

bindings.label: Toggle Mobile Share
bindings.description: Start or stop the phone-facing mobile share using the current Mobile settings route.

bindings.label: Save File
bindings.description: Reserved for editor save actions.

bindings.label: New File
bindings.description: Create a new file in the active explorer folder.

bindings.label: New Folder
bindings.description: Create a new folder in the active explorer folder.

bindings.label: Rename Item
bindings.description: Rename the current explorer selection.

bindings.label: Delete Item
bindings.description: Delete the current explorer selection.

bindings.label: Duplicate Item
bindings.description: Duplicate the current explorer selection.

bindings.label: Refresh Explorer
bindings.description: Reload the current explorer directory.

bindings.label: Go Back
bindings.description: Navigate back through explorer history.

bindings.label: Go Forward
bindings.description: Navigate forward through explorer history.

bindings.label: Go Home
bindings.description: Jump to the explorer home directory.

bindings.label: Clear Explorer Search
bindings.description: Clear the current explorer search query.

bindings.label: Cycle Explorer Search Mode
bindings.description: Cycle explorer search among name, content, and semantic modes.

bindings.label: Find Similar File
bindings.description: Run semantic similarity search for the active local text/code selection.

bindings.label: Cycle Sort Key
bindings.description: Step through explorer sort keys.

bindings.label: Toggle Sort Order
bindings.description: Flip the current explorer sort order.

bindings.label: Focus Explorer List
bindings.description: Focus the main file list.

bindings.label: Focus Explorer Address Bar
bindings.description: Focus the explorer address bar.

bindings.label: Focus Explorer Preview
bindings.description: Focus the explorer preview panel.

bindings.label: Toggle Sources Panel
bindings.description: Show or hide the explorer sources panel.

bindings.label: Cycle Collection Preview Mode
bindings.description: Advance the shared folder and archive preview pane through its collection preview modes.

bindings.label: Reverse Collection Preview Mode
bindings.description: Move backward through the shared folder and archive preview pane collection preview modes.

bindings.label: Toggle Preview Lock
bindings.description: Lock or unlock the active explorer preview so selection changes stop replacing it.

bindings.label: Explorer Move Selection Up
bindings.description: Move the current explorer selection upward. Icon layouts follow the visible grid.

bindings.label: Explorer Move Selection Down
bindings.description: Move the current explorer selection downward. Icon layouts follow the visible grid.

bindings.label: Explorer Move Selection Left
bindings.description: Move the current explorer selection left. In icon layouts this follows the row layout.

bindings.label: Explorer Move Selection Right
bindings.description: Move the current explorer selection right. In icon layouts this follows the row layout.

bindings.label: Toggle Preview Terminal
bindings.description: Show or hide the embedded preview-pane terminal in the active explorer.

bindings.label: Open in Terminal
bindings.description: Open the selected folder in a terminal.

bindings.label: Calculate Recursive Size
bindings.description: Measure folder sizes for the current selection or visible entries.

bindings.label: Reveal in Explorer
bindings.description: Reveal the selected item in the system file explorer.

bindings.label: Open as Admin
bindings.description: Open the selected item with elevated permissions.

bindings.label: Extract Archive Folder Here
bindings.description: Extract the current archive folder into the archive container directory.

bindings.label: Extract Archive Folder to New Folder
bindings.description: Extract the current archive folder into a fresh wrapper folder beside the archive.

bindings.label: Go Up Directory
bindings.description: Navigate to the parent folder in Explorer.

bindings.label: Copy Path
bindings.description: Copy the selected path(s) to the system clipboard.

bindings.label: Copy Selection
bindings.description: Copy the current explorer selection into the transfer queue, or toggle Explorer selection mode when nothing is selected.

bindings.label: Cut Selection
bindings.description: Cut the current explorer selection into the transfer queue.

bindings.label: Paste Selection
bindings.description: Paste the current transfer queue into the active folder.

bindings.label: Toggle Hidden Files
bindings.description: Show or hide hidden files in Explorer.

bindings.label: Toggle Explorer Layout
bindings.description: Step through the explorer content-browser layouts.

bindings.label: Explorer Customize Layout UI
bindings.description: Open or save the ZBrush-style explorer layout customization mode.

bindings.label: Open Explorer Layout Switcher
bindings.description: Open the explorer layout package switcher and canonical reset command center.

bindings.label: Cycle Constellation Lens
bindings.description: Step through the active Constellation relationship lens while the canvas is focused.

bindings.label: Toggle Constellation Route
bindings.description: Highlight the top likely next moves from the active Constellation anchor.

bindings.label: Toggle Constellation Workset Pin
bindings.description: Pin or unpin the current explorer selection inside the active Constellation workset.

bindings.label: Select All
bindings.description: Select every visible explorer entry.

bindings.label: Clear Explorer Selection
bindings.description: Clear the current explorer selection.

bindings.label: Search Explorer
bindings.description: Focus the explorer search/address bar.

bindings.label: PDF Workbench Previous Page
bindings.description: Jump to the previous page in the explorer PDF workbench.

bindings.label: PDF Workbench Next Page
bindings.description: Jump to the next page in the explorer PDF workbench.

bindings.label: PDF Workbench Zoom In
bindings.description: Increase the active PDF preview zoom level.

bindings.label: PDF Workbench Zoom Out
bindings.description: Decrease the active PDF preview zoom level.

bindings.label: PDF Workbench Toggle Edit Mode
bindings.description: Toggle between preview and edit mode for the explorer PDF workbench.

bindings.label: Shader Workbench Toggle Edit Mode
bindings.description: Toggle between preview and edit mode for the explorer shader workbench.

bindings.label: Shader Workbench Toggle Scene
bindings.description: Toggle the active shader preview scene between the sphere and fullscreen hosts.

bindings.label: Spreadsheet Workbench Toggle Edit Mode
bindings.description: Toggle between preview and edit mode for the explorer spreadsheet workbench.

bindings.label: Spreadsheet Previous Sheet
bindings.description: Move to the previous sheet in the spreadsheet workbench.

bindings.label: Spreadsheet Next Sheet
bindings.description: Move to the next sheet in the spreadsheet workbench.

bindings.label: Spreadsheet New Sheet
bindings.description: Create a new sheet in the spreadsheet workbench.

bindings.label: Spreadsheet Focus Formula Bar
bindings.description: Jump focus to the active spreadsheet formula bar.

bindings.label: Audio Workbench Play/Pause
bindings.description: Toggle native audio playback in the audio workbench.

bindings.label: Audio Workbench Toggle Edit Mode
bindings.description: Switch between the clean audio preview player and the full audio editor.

bindings.label: Audio Workbench Jump To In
bindings.description: Move the playhead to the current trim in-point.

bindings.label: Audio Workbench Jump To Out
bindings.description: Move the playhead to the current trim out-point.

bindings.label: Audio Workbench Previous Silence
bindings.description: Jump to the previous detected silence region.

bindings.label: Audio Workbench Next Silence
bindings.description: Jump to the next detected silence region.

bindings.label: Audio Workbench Export Clip
bindings.description: Open the clip export flow from the audio workbench.

bindings.label: Python Workbench Run Managed
bindings.description: Run the active Python preview through the managed Python runtime.

bindings.label: Python Workbench Run In Terminal
bindings.description: Queue the active Python preview into the explorer embedded terminal.

bindings.label: Image Cutout Copy
bindings.description: Copy the active explorer cutout selection as a transparent image to the system clipboard.

bindings.label: Image Cutout Deselect
bindings.description: Clear the current explorer cutout selection without resetting the cutout session.

bindings.label: Image Editor Undo
bindings.description: Undo the last canvas edit inside the explorer image editor.

bindings.label: Image Editor Redo
bindings.description: Redo the last undone canvas edit inside the explorer image editor.

bindings.label: Image Editor Reset
bindings.description: Restore the image editor to the last saved base grade and overlay state.

bindings.label: Close Tab
bindings.description: Reserved for tab close actions.

bindings.label: Find
bindings.description: Reserved for search actions.

bindings.label: Replace
bindings.description: Reserved for replace actions.
